test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, MOSAIC is coded as 47-68 and USEFUL is coded as 45-42. How will FLYING be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Code = (sum of the positional value of the first 3 letters) - (sum of the positional value of opposite letters of the last 3 letters)

MOSAIC is coded as 47-68

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ac74045f0c44dbc0e77471daeb8b4060ee75846254609c678923dff8a6df5b3.png] 

 

And,

USEFUL is coded as 45-42

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3a8ca128b339e4d6e6780f2fb4a07e9323de0a4b217dc368bca9eb2235fc124.png] 

 

Similarly,

FLYING be coded as

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81be2143796e257000d3872f1dc9593d612bd6a5bc852580d6bbd25cea2dd883.png] 

Hence, **'**FLYING**'** will be written as “43-51”.
